purpose: Semantic isomorphism audit against the 24-template catalog and GAP/action families. NOT for generator optimization.

TEMPLATE_INSTANCE.definition: Direct parameterization of an existing template family with same scientific uncertainty, population axis, outcome, and relation type.
examples: T8 dispersion template with different horizon only
GAP_STABILITY candidate with standard stability question text

TEMPLATE_REFRAME.definition: Same underlying scientific uncertainty under another frame, population label, or outcome representation without new observational axis.
examples: Same dispersion question with pop=high_vol renamed to pop=elevated_realized_vol
Outcome switched from return_5d to return_10d without new motivating observation

TEMPLATE_ADJACENT.definition: Meaningfully related to encoded catalog but extends beyond the implicit scientific question — new contrast, interaction, or conditional structure motivated by observation.
examples: Observation of joint tail concentration motivates conditional dispersion within liquidity tier — not in base T8 text
Temporal regime shift in spread-residual correlation — adjacent to stability family but new axis

SCIENTIFICALLY_NOVEL.definition: Scientific uncertainty not implicitly specified by existing template catalog or GAP semantics.
examples: Cross-sectional interaction between two empirical residuals not mapped to any GAP family
Observation-driven question about transition asymmetry between market states with no template family

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.definition: Cannot establish observational grounding or answer birth certificate from recorded evidence.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.action: REJECT from autonomous set; may log for diagnostics

evaluation_pipeline.step_1: Normalize proposition to canonical_proposition_core + population + outcome + horizon + relation
evaluation_pipeline.step_2: Embed proposition and each template family core question (offline, frozen embeddings v1)
evaluation_pipeline.step_3: Compute semantic similarity matrix + structural feature match (GAP family, action type, tool path)
evaluation_pipeline.step_4: Apply decision tree (frozen thresholds, see below)
evaluation_pipeline.step_5: Human adjudication sample 10% for calibration — never fed back to generator during BB-Prop-01

decision_tree_frozen_v1.note: Thresholds chosen from template catalog structure analysis, NOT from BB-Prop-01 outcomes

rules.if: structural_match_score >= 0.95 AND semantic_similarity >= 0.92 AND no new_observational_axis_documented
structural_match_score >= 0.85 AND semantic_similarity >= 0.85 AND same_gap_family AND new_observational_axis_documented == false
same_gap_family OR semantic_similarity >= 0.70 AND new_observational_axis_documented == true
birth_certificate incomplete OR observation_provenance fails minimum payload

decision_tree_frozen_v1.new_observational_axis_documented: birth_certificate BC_Q2 cites empirical statistic not reducible to template default motivation

generator_must_not: Read evaluator thresholds during candidate generation
Tune phrasing to land just below semantic_similarity cutoff
Use evaluator feedback loops during development except abstract capability buckets
anti_optimization.evaluator_runs: Once per frozen commit for blind benchmark; development set uses separate non-blind diagnostics only
